# testdata

`flip.json` is the Chief FLIP_PATH fixture (`mode` + `call_gate=3`). Change it with temp write + `mv` only (see `mockmcp.WriteFlip`).

`pin.json` is generated by:

```bash
go run ./cmd/deadbugz-guard --write-pin --pin testdata/pin.json --from-mode benign
```

Compose mounts this directory as `/data` for the wrap service.
